# Historical red baseline: default mode reported unsupported paths only when explicitly requested
# or when their presence changed, omitting modified authoritative .meta files.
if ($explicitPathRequest -or $basePresent -ne $headPresent) {
    Write-Output '  semantic   NOT CHECKED'
}

# Historical red baseline also treated image/light data and unknown generated files as the same
# unsupported bucket, with no byte/hash provenance, GUID evidence, or asset/.meta pair coverage.
$coverageKind = 'unsupported binary'
Write-Output '  kind       unsupported metadata'
Write-Output 'COVERAGE: selected paths only'
